content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x06, 0x10 or 0x19, the Dcm module shall calculate the statusOfDTC by first calling Dem_SelectDTC() with the parameters values set according to Table 7.15 and then Dem_GetStatusOfDTC() with ClientId = Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDem- ClientRef ).
